article.intro: Every elf in Santa's workshop has a name that sounds like Christmas, and a job to go with it. This **Christmas elf name generator** turns your first name into an elf name, like Sam Jinglebottom, or makes a random one, and can give you a job too: Head of Wrapping, perhaps, or Chief Toy Tester.

sections.heading: What's my elf name?
sections.content:
Type your first name and the generator keeps it, then adds an elf surname made from Christmas things: Sam Jinglebottom, Sarah Sugarsparks.

  • Add a job to find out what you'd do in Santa's workshop, from Tinsel Untangler to Keeper of the Naughty List.
  • Or go random for a full elf name with no link to your own.
  • For a group, run everyone's names through it for a Christmas party, an office game or a family card.

sections.heading: Christmas elves in folklore
sections.content:
Santa's busy workshop elves are a fairly modern idea, but they grew out of much older household spirits.

  • The Scandinavian nisse or tomte is a small farm spirit who looks after the house and animals. On Christmas Eve families leave him a bowl of rice porridge with butter; forget, and he plays tricks.
  • Iceland's Yule Lads are thirteen mischievous brothers who visit one by one in the thirteen nights before Christmas, each with his own habit, like Spoon-Licker and Door-Slammer.

For an elf that lives on a shelf, try the Elf on the Shelf Name Generator. For elves of the other kind, there's the Elf Name Generator.

For the rest of the season, see all the Christmas name generators.

faqs.question: How do I get my elf name?
faqs.answer: Choose My name, type your first name and generate. You'll get your name with an elf surname, like Sam Jinglebottom, and you can add a workshop job.

faqs.question: What is a nisse?
faqs.answer: A small household spirit from Scandinavian folklore, also called a tomte, who looks after the farm. Families leave him rice porridge on Christmas Eve.

faqs.question: What jobs do Santa's elves do?
faqs.answer: In the generator, everything from Toy Train Driver and Sleigh Mechanic to Head of Wrapping and Keeper of the Naughty List.
